findings.F1: In the falling profile, the drop after volume shrinkage sits almost entirely in the strongest shrink. The lowest quintile of the 30-day log volume ratio (mean −0.76) is followed by an excess 5-day return of −3.6 % (day-clustered t −1.83, 81 non-overlapping cases). The other quintiles show −0.9 %, −0.3 %, +1.8 % and +0.5 %, none with |t| above 1.4. This makes the idea's average size small: an unusual move of +0.72 % with t 1.46 and a total move of +0.13 %, against a cost of 0.19 % per trade.
findings.F2: In rising markets (60-day return above +10 %), volume shrinkage is followed by the opposite of the tested effect: the coin rises more.
findings.F3: The rising-market effect shows in both agitation states, at each end of the volume ratio.
findings.F4: Read across both trends, volume shrinkage goes with continuation of the coin's 60-day direction. The trend-signed excess 5-day return on the volume ratio has a slope of −0.029 (t −1.70, 719 cases). Over all bars, with no trend split, the slope is −0.0005 (t −0.03, 846 cases): the effect only appears once it is signed by the trend.
findings.F5: Inside the falling profile, the shrinkage effect leans on calm markets.
findings.F6: The book's gain depends on a few windows and a few days.
findings.F7: No other angle stood out against the many looked at. None of these reached |t| ≥ 2 in any quintile:

ideas.idea: In a rising market, the more a coin's trading volume over the past 30 days has shrunk against the 30 days before, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: An uptrend that keeps going on drying volume has no sellers left to stop it, so a trader would hold or add to longs in it rather than read the thin volume as a warning.
ideas.name: rising volume dry-up continuation

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the more a coin's trading volume over the past 30 days has shrunk against the 30 days before, the larger its fall over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: The dry-up short belongs in quiet downtrends, where selling seeps out unabsorbed, and not in agitated ones, where it shows no edge.
ideas.name: calm fall volume dry-up
